name: Headless session lifecycle
description: Create, list, status and destroy explicitly identified private labwc desktops that survive client disconnect.
limitations: CI evidence: 37244764863; Fedora/Arch are containers with repaired runtimes, not desktop installs.
NixOS evidence is historical docs/retained artifacts, not rerun in this review.
Graphical separation only; one output, pixman, scale 1; unbounded retained sessions.

name: Process ownership and crash recovery
description: Private D-Bus, worker/guardian subreapers, descendant/token cleanup and dead-supervisor recovery.
limitations: Tokenless processes can escape after both supervisors die; host-service processes and PID reuse remain boundaries.
Latest CI repeats crash recovery on Ubuntu; repetition is not proof for every failure ordering.

name: Application launch and logs
description: Launch argument lists in private HOME/display/bus, report PIDs/exits and read retained log tails.
limitations: No allowlist or filesystem/network sandbox; environment and cwd inherited beyond overrides.
Delivery/startup does not imply widget readiness; per-file log bounds are not aggregate quotas.

name: Keyboard and Unicode
description: Persistent US-layout virtual keyboard, spare Unicode keys, named chords and 1–100 repeats.
limitations: 10,000-character request limit; unsupported control characters rejected; IME/dead keys unverified.
Recent Fedora receipt failures unresolved; Ubuntu Chromium path skips in latest CI.
NixOS loaded repetitions are historical reports.

name: Pointer, click, drag and scroll
description: Session-local absolute motion, buttons, interpolated drag and scroll.
limitations: Single output at scale 1; no modifier-held drag or configurable drag speed.
Compositor delivery acknowledgement is not application success.

name: Screenshots, crops and scaling
description: Retained PNG images plus dimensions, region, scale and image-coordinate token.
limitations: Real CI tests inspected; no new capture performed in this review.
Exhausted stability retries still return a token; retention has no quota.
With a token coordinates are image pixels; without one desktop pixels.

name: Window enumeration and focus
description: Foreign-toplevel IDs, titles, app IDs, states and parents; activation waits for observed state.
limitations: No geometry/child-widget map; activated does not prove app keyboard readiness.
Four existing focus unit tests rerun here; latest Ubuntu CI has repeated real focus checks.

name: Observation guards
description: Optional layout tokens refuse input when output, toplevel state or ownership epoch changes.
limitations: No pixels, geometry, UI contents or title checks; optional before ordinary input; unavoidable check/delivery gap.
Takeover requires a new screenshot, which currently can be unstable.

name: Read-only viewer
description: CLI TigerVNC observer with server-side input disabled over a private Unix socket.
limitations: Protocol behavior covered in CI; graphical viewer window historically observed only on NixOS/Hyprland.
Requires wayvnc and an X11/Xwayland host viewer; existing stream remains visible during takeover.
No TCP listener does not provide same-UID confidentiality.

name: Human takeover and paste
description: Agent request/control tools, CLI take/release, separate interactive VNC and post-release observation gate.
limitations: MCP exposes request/control only; take/release intentionally CLI/core.
No real-site login or actual agent handoff verified; same-user callers can release; US keymap.
Clipboard failure logs a warning and resumes anyway; RFB automation is not a human usability test.

name: Named profiles
description: Persistent HOME for logins/config, profile list/size and exclusive active-session flock.
limitations: Deletion CLI/core only; check/delete race; profile lock does not span guardian crash cleanup.
Cookie test skipped on latest Ubuntu; historical NixOS and Fedora/Arch evidence.
Cookies readable by same UID and any agent assigned that profile; real accounts unverified.

name: Window, screen and semantic waits
description: Client-side polling for windows/elements and screen stability; optional plain delay.
limitations: Polling, not a generic event subscription; <=400 px² change bounding boxes treated as quiet.
Combined predicates not simultaneous/scoped; truncated trees cannot establish absence.
Timeout not end-to-end; Chromium caret test skipped on latest Ubuntu.

name: Action sequences
description: Up to 50 input/focus/wait/UI steps with per-step observation baselines and completed/stopped result.
limitations: No exclusive multi-client lease; in-window changes invisible; post-step observe can escape result handling.
Sequence counts reduce round trips, not necessarily primitive actions or cost.

name: Semantic UI and AT-SPI actions
description: Private registry; filtered UI listing; native actions/text with Chromium keyboard fallback.
limitations: GTK evidence on all four; Chromium CI evidence Fedora/Arch, historical NixOS; Ubuntu browser skips.
Qt semantic test test_ui.QtUITests.test_qt_input_dialog is historically reported on NixOS only and skipped in all latest CI jobs.
LibreOffice/Electron semantic flows and large trees unverified; blocking traversal, response cap and recycled IDs.

name: Stdio MCP adapter
description: Existing-agent tools over stdio with real PNG content, instructions and persistent sessions.
limitations: Actual model-client task evidence is historical NixOS only, not every MCP client.
Sync handlers block event loop; CLI returns structured UI JSON while MCP compacts it to text.
Intentional human-only CLI operations are not MCP tools; same-UID enforcement remains cooperative.

name: Visible nested mode
description: Opt-in private labwc window for testing on a Wayland host.
limitations: Always skipped in CI and not run here.
Focused nested window receives physical keyboard input and can take host focus; not the no-interference default.

name: Application workflow fixtures
description: Native Chromium, xterm, GTK/Qt dialogs, Mousepad save/clipboard and Writer/Calc saved-file checks.
limitations: Uses actual apps but mostly synthetic workflows; fixture delays and explicit profiles are required.
Qt on NixOS historical only; no broad Qt distro evidence from tests that silently omit missing kdialog.
No representative sustained daily work established.

name: Benchmark suites and restricted baseline
description: Standard 20, hard 10 and office 2 task definitions, independent verifiers, tool-profile and Cua metrics.
limitations: Harness scripts are command-line programs but not agent-desktop CLI/MCP capabilities.
No agent benchmark run in this review; raw/export consistency and fixture hashes checked.
Single model; saturation, changing prompts/runtime/cache and unmatched environments limit inference; office model result is one 2-task run.

name: Project-local wlroots runtime repair
description: Pinned source patch maps a pre-buffered Xwayland surface after association; copied labwc loads private library.
tests: CI 37244764863: 100 loaded X11 repetitions each on Fedora and Arch
limitations: Backend dependency, not a Python/MCP feature; Ubuntu uses stock older runtime and is not evidence for this patch.
NixOS 150/100 historical loaded experiments; only one recorded buffer-before-association recovery.
Exact 0.19.3/0.20.2 ABI/dev packages; no reusable NixOS build recipe or upstream retirement link.
